name: Agents
author: Omarchy
description: Every AI coding subscription's usage, limits, and pace in one native Omarchy bar panel.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: every subscription stacked in a single column, with rate-limit meters, prepaid balances, today, the last week, and the all-time model breakdown.

schema.label: Synced aggregation
schema.description: When On, write this machine's local usage snapshot and merge snapshots from other machines.

schema.label: Sync folder
schema.description: A folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync, etc.

schema.label: Snapshot file name
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to <hostname>.json. Use a different file name on each machine, such as laptop.json or desktop.json.

schema.label: Device id
schema.description: Optional stable device name used inside synced aggregate snapshots.
